what: The official results are in Government Gazette No. 52 (16 November 2018), signed by the Supervisor of Elections (Ag.): Yes 9,848, No 12,134, rejected 116, voted 22,098, enrolled 79,410 (27.83%). Wikipedia gives 119 invalid, and a second Wikipedia table gives the preliminary 9,846 and 12,133.
action: The Gazette figures are now used, down to polling station.
